info.name: Grid Agent Management Exchange Rates API

params.name: sourceCurrency
params.description: Filter by source currency code (e.g., USD)

params.name: destinationCurrency
params.description: Filter by destination currency code(s). Can be repeated for multiple currencies (e.g., &destinationCurrency=INR&destinationCurrency=GBP)

params.name: sendingAmount
params.description: Sending amount in the smallest unit of the source currency (e.g., cents for USD).  If no amount is provided, the default is 10000 in the sending currency smallest unit.

items.docs:
Retrieve cached exchange rates for currency corridors. Returns FX rates that are cached
for approximately 5 minutes. Rates include fees specific to your platform for authenticated requests.

**Filtering Options:**
- Filter by source currency to get all available destination corridors
- Filter by specific destination currency or currencies
- Provide a sending amount to get calculated receiving amounts
